rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a true, established fact or the facts underlying a case.

example.english: This fact is completely different from what he said.
example.traditional: 呢個事實同佢講嘅完全唔一樣。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 si6 sat6 tung4 keoi5 gong2 ge3 jyun4 cyun4 m4 jat1 joeng6

rows.note: Use this when the fact means the true state of affairs behind a story, dispute, or concealment.

example.english: We finally found out the fact behind the whole story.
example.traditional: 我哋終於知道成件事嘅真相喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 zi1 dou3 sing4 gin6 si6 ge3 zan1 soeng3 laa3

rows.note: Use this for information or data about a subject rather than for a proven proposition.

example.english: I found a fact in the data for you to use in your report.
example.traditional: 我喺啲資料入面發現咗一個事實，俾你寫報告。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 di1 zi1 liu6 jap6 min6 faat3 jin6 zo2 jat1 go3 si6 sat6 bei2 nei5 se2 bou3 gou3

rows.note: Use this when facts are being treated as concrete evidence supporting a conclusion.

example.english: This evidence establishes the fact that he was lying.
example.traditional: 呢份證據證明佢當時講緊大話。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 zing3 geoi3 zing3 ming4 keoi5 dong1 si4 gong2 gan2 daai6 waa6
